title: Simple Changes proposal sources
description: File beside the review ledger at `proposal-sources.json`: for each proposal, the local branch `proposal record-authors` found at its exact recorded head, and the remote branch that branch tracked. The review ledger binds a proposal to commits only and older runtimes read its closed shape strictly, so this binding is kept in its own file, which they never open. `loop finalize` reads it to name the proposal that carries a Queue or Sweep run's pushed branch; a missing or unreadable file holds no binding.
